name: client-object-test-cc3f260977/remote-basic-negative-e.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: lists New expression, but does not list object-constructor-expr (anonymous object constructors).
## Module-level declarations: Class definition — Supports remote-method-defn for client classes and resource-method-defn for service classes
## Expressions: Client remote method call action
reason: The case includes three anonymous client object constructors in clientFunc and asserts rejection of duplicate ordinary/remote methods inside them. Object constructor expressions are not covered by the supported expression list; support for class definitions and new expressions does not establish support for anonymous client object expressions. This essential portion makes the whole case a feature request.
unsupported_constructs: Anonymous client object constructor expressions: var x/y/z = client object { ... }, including duplicate-method diagnostics within those expressions
test_design_notes: This is a compile-negative case with @error assertions; no @args, @panic, or @output directives occur.
Illegal remote declarations/calls and duplicate class methods alone do not make this a feature case: negative rejection within supported grammar/type checking is in scope.
